name: St Michael and St Bernadette, Whitefield

boundary.description: From the junction of Ringley Road and Wood Street, E along Ringely Road (A667) to and along W and then N boundary of a Stand Golf Course, to Chapelfield and by the N and W boundaries of Stand Golf Course to and W along Ringley Road to its junction with Wood Street and across Hollinhurst Playing Fields, excluding Oak Street and Beech Street to Radcliffe New Road and by a bee line to River Irwell and N to its confluence with River Roch, N by River Roch to its confluence with and E along Hollins Brook, crossing Croft Lane and M66 Motorway, then along Whittle Brook to M62 Motorway and S to junction 18, then along M60 to the railway just before Junction 17. N along the railway, then W along Moss Lane, Pinfold Lane, Park Lane Philips Park Road West to its end at Hill Crest and by a beeline to and along M60 Motorway to and N along Salford-Bury District Boundary and Bolton-Bury District Boundary to its crossing with Rigley Road (A667).
